name: questra
_scripts_note: check:all covers the packages that EXIST. As each later package lands (engine, server, ai), the session that creates it adds its check here — nothing may silently drop out of the gate.

scripts.precheck:all: npm run build:contracts && npm run build -w @questra/ui && npm run build -w @questra/engine && npm run build -w @questra/ai
scripts.check:all: npm run check -w @questra/contracts && npm run check -w @questra/theme && npm run check -w @questra/ui && npm run check -w @questra/web && npm run check -w @questra/engine && npm run check -w @questra/ai && npm run check -w @questra/server
scripts.build-storybook: npm run build:contracts && npm run build-storybook -w @questra/web
